about: Through real clippy on a planted crate: each #[expect(clippy::disallowed_methods)] is one site per configured method its item calls (a method called twice once, a macro's call at its call site), an attribute whose compiled item calls none is refused even under #[allow(unfulfilled_lint_expectations)], one in an item this platform does not compile (cfg(any()), compiled nowhere) is counted as uncompiled, never refused, and a call under #[allow] or a string naming the attribute is no site (2.1-M223)

files.clippy.toml:
disallowed-methods = [
  { path = "std::thread::spawn", reason = "planted" },
  { path = "std::thread::scope", reason = "planted" },
  { path = "std::thread::Builder::spawn", reason = "planted" },
]
